solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides integrated full-text and faceted search across Hindustan Times's application data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Hindustan Times's workload.

data_flow: Operational events and application data flow into MongoDB Atlas Search, where the platform stores current state and supports real-time queries for downstream applications and integrations such as AWS, Elasticsearch.
business_outcome: More efficiencies, more time for innovation
metrics: In 2025, Hindustan Times received over 270 million unique visitors each month, with a widespread, global audience — 40% of its traffic comes from outside India.
As of 2025, Hindustan Times is operating ten MongoDB clusters across a wide range of applications and workloads, with more to come.
